notice: Producer research decision only. Independent review and owner adoption remain separate.
rationale: EO 12701 only amends EO 12334 by replacing the second sentence of its section 1. That command was spent when the order issued on 1990-02-14, and the replacement sentence lived inside EO 12334 until EO 12863 (September 13, 1993, section 3.3) revoked EO 12334 as amended. The held Federal Register original has no other clause. The single catalog observation only says the order amends EO 12334. No held source shows a later revival, so the order is not in force on 2026-10-14.
